scientific_question: Do independently defined observational QPP reference classifications retain their selected/not-selected status and selected period under prospectively frozen temporal-window, processing, admissibility, and numerical perturbations at catalogue scale?
primary_contribution: Catalogue-scale robustness of independently defined observational QPP classifications under a deliberately F2-connected, prospectively frozen perturbation and numerical-audit contract; not a new TESS QPP catalogue and not a validation/correction study.
reference_label_policy: Primary source BAIIW0001 labels define observational reference roles; external labels remain independently provenanced; observational labels are not physical ground truth.

afino_execution_contract.effective_version: AFINO 0.5 convention inherited from frozen F0-F2

analysis_plan.multiplicity_policy: No inferential p-value family; report the complete frozen grid and denominators without result-dependent selection.

documented_limitation.description: BAII froze the scientific source choice but did not freeze the exact machine-readable BAIIW0001 event table/schema or native TESS product identifiers. F3A.2 must locate, checksum, and map these before cohort materialization.
documented_limitation.prohibited_resolution: Do not silently substitute another catalogue, infer missing event identifiers, or use F3A outcomes to repair source provenance.
documented_limitation.amendment_if_unresolved: phase3a-design-v2 with explicit scientific decision record before any F3A result is inspected.

next_task: F3A.2 — deterministic cohort materialization, provenance/admissibility verification, and exact execution-plan freeze before AFINO.
